steps.description: An attacker analyzes `frontend/.env.example` to identify the names and expected format of sensitive environment variables, aiding in subsequent targeted credential harvesting or environment variable injection attacks.
An attacker reviews `frontend/package.json`, `frontend/package-lock.json`, and `Move.toml` to discover vulnerable software dependencies or identify potential targets for dependency confusion attacks.

An attacker examines `Move.toml`, `frontend/package.json`, and `frontend/tsconfig.json` to identify sensitive build configurations, internal resource paths, or exposed deployment details that could lead to further exploitation.
